title: Care Desk Guidance — Mid-Term Plan Changes on Residential Natural Gas Supply
content:
A Residential Natural Gas Supply customer may move an active gas agreement to another Beacon Ridge gas plan when the current plan allows a mid-term plan change. The desk applies the following rules.

**Status.** A plan change is made only on an active agreement, as the agreement's status in the company's records shows.

**Which plans may be chosen.** A mid-term change is allowed only to a plan whose term in months is equal to or longer than the current plan's term, except within the current plan's fee-free window before the contract end date (the plan's early termination fee-free window in calendar days), when any plan may be chosen. Moving from a month-to-month plan to any plan with a term is always allowed.

**Eligibility.** The new plan must satisfy the gas enrollment eligibility rules.

**Effective date and rate.** The change takes effect at the start of the next billing cycle, at the offer rate of the price offer for the new plan and the premise's gas utility valid on that date, and the new term is counted from the plan change date.

**Fees.** An allowed plan change carries no early termination fee when the plan's upgrade waiver applies, and a thermostat already shipped carries no recovery fee because the agreement continues.

**Credits.** A plan change earns no sign-up credit and no renewal loyalty credit.

### Plan choice table (hypothetical current plans)

| Current plan (term) | Requested plan (term) | Inside the current plan's fee-free window | Change allowed |
|---|---|---|---|
| Beacon Ridge Gas Price Lock 24 (24) | Beacon Ridge Gas Price Lock 36 (36) | No | Yes (longer term) |
| Beacon Ridge Gas Price Lock 24 (24) | Beacon Ridge Carbon Offset Gas 24 (24) | No | Yes (equal term) |
| Beacon Ridge Gas Price Lock 24 (24) | Beacon Ridge Gas Price Lock 12 (12) | No | No (shorter term) |
| Beacon Ridge Gas Price Lock 24 (24) | Beacon Ridge Gas Price Lock 12 (12) | Yes | Yes (any plan inside the window) |
| Beacon Ridge Gas Monthly Variable (0) | Beacon Ridge Gas Capped Variable 12 (12) | — | Yes (month-to-month to a plan with a term) |

### Illustration (hypothetical dates)

A customer on an active agreement whose current cycle ends 14 March moves to a longer plan on 3 March. The change takes effect on 15 March, the start of the next cycle, at the new plan's offer rate valid on 15 March, and the new term is counted from 15 March.
